claimed_values.Turbine_unavailability_claim: Over 40% of turbines lack usable pitch sensors

quarantined_items.quarantine_reason: Legacy rebuild script calculated (physics[..., 1] != 0).mean() and misnamed it 'window_pitch_coverage'. This is the Region 3 pitching rate. True feature_mask coverage is 97.32% (Kelmarsh) and 99.13% (Penmanshiel). Pitch = 0 deg is valid normal Region 2 MPPT operation, not sensor missingness.
quarantined_items.action: Withdraw the claim that commercial wind farms have 55%/78% sensor coverage or that 40% of turbines lack sensors. Refocus solely on controlled communication/sensor stress-testing.

quarantined_items.quarantine_reason: When delaying or corrupting anchor_physics, history_delay was left False, so the model encoder's x_hist input still contained the uncorrupted, contemporary sensor readings at issue time t. Baseline rules only saw the delayed values. The high recall reflects information asymmetry, not genuine robustness to sensor dropouts.
quarantined_items.action: Quarantine headline numbers. Re-evaluate under unified ArrivalDataFeed where x_hist and anchor are synchronously degraded.

quarantined_items.action: Correct analytical text to 1 - 1/rho. Verify numerical optimization scripts use the exact cost function directly.
